decisions.statement: Every device said, at its flag or as a word, is moved to in one call.
The devices reach Spotify in the order the call wrote them.
A call naming no device is refused rather than moving anything.
`--play` is what starts the device moved to, and a call without it says none.
A call saying `--json` is answered one line of JSON, and one saying nothing words.
The move is handed in, so no test of it reaches Spotify.

definition: the command moving Spotify playback onto the devices a call names
